title: Remove duplicated JSDoc opener above JobRegistry.onJobsChanged
task: packages/jobs/jobs/src/index.ts:145-146 opens the JSDoc block for `JobRegistry.onJobsChanged` with two consecutive `/**` lines instead of one: line 145 is `  /**` and line 146 repeats `  /**` before the actual comment text starts on line 147 (`* Register an effect-scoped observer of visible-set changes.`). Every other abstract method in this file (e.g. `onJobDone` at lines 135-143, `attachController` at lines 169-176) opens its doc comment with exactly one `/**` line. The stray second `/**` is inert (TypeScript still parses the block because `/**` nested inside a block comment is just text), so it produces no compile or lint failure, but it is a leftover edit artifact that a documentation generator or a reader following this file as the authoritative JSDoc source (see docs/subsystems/jobs.md's stated sourcing from this file) would see as a formatting defect. Delete the duplicate `/**` line so the block opens once, matching the style of every other method in the file. Touch only that one line; do not reword the comment text or change any other method's documentation.
